stages.rule: C in E1 iff |FIT(C) - FIT_best| <= max(SE_delta(C, best), 0.01)
stages.note: practical-equivalence set, NOT a top-K truncation

stages.rule: within E1: BLOCK_WORST practical-equivalence restriction, then exact argmin of SHOT_P90
within E2: exact argmin of |C|, then exact argmin of ACTIVE_TERMS(C)
within E3: exact argmin of COND_MEDIAN, then COND_P90, then COND_MAX
within E4: max BOOT_SELECTION_FREQ, then max FOLD_SELECTION_FREQ, then canonical support ID

parsimony_definition.first: |C|, the number of scientific coordinates, from registry support_size

active_terms.definition: the number of explanatory columns whose OLS coefficient is not exactly zero under ordinary floating arithmetic

aggregation_rule.OR-05: a column is ACTIVE for C iff its coefficient is not exactly 0.0 in at least one of the 60 calibration fits; ACTIVE_TERMS(C) is the count of active columns
aggregation_rule.rationale: coefficients are discharge/block local, so the criterion needs a candidate-level integer; the union rule is the conservative reading (a term counts as used if it is used anywhere) and requires no threshold

active_terms.expected_behaviour: under full-rank OLS an exactly-zero coefficient essentially never occurs, so ACTIVE_TERMS(C) = |C| and the second parsimony subcriterion is non-binding, exactly as the parent anticipates

canonical_tie_break.rule: lexicographic ascending byte order of the canonical support_id
canonical_tie_break.role: FINAL deterministic tie-break at every rank
canonical_tie_break.sufficient: support_ids are unique across Ahat_rec, so the tie-break always resolves to exactly one candidate

determinism.reproducibility_requirement: identical inputs must yield an identical selected candidate

required_verifications: artifact hashes match the S7.7R recorded manifest
estimator equivalence: DEVELOPMENT_RELATION_OLS_V1 == SEARCH_PROXY_OLS_V1 for the fit criterion
metric equivalence: NRMSE definition, scale and ddof unchanged
support identity: canonical support_id set matches Ahat_rec exactly
block identity: the 60 cells match the frozen development cohort and block windows
preconditions_before_reusing_s7_7r_array.s7_8_status: all five verified in S7.8; S7.9 must re-verify at execution time

forbidden_in_execution: selecting a candidate before the ranks are computed in order
introducing a tolerance not defined in this algorithm
domain_reading: every quantity defined here is evaluated over the frozen explored frontier Ahat_rec only; A_rec minus Ahat_rec remains ADMISSIBLE_UNSEARCHED and carries no negative finding
